title: Pulse Console visual upgrade

visual: Full driver-console visual pass after lifecycle controls are simplified
Stronger ride hierarchy, cleaner spacing, fewer glass panels and internal labels
Use route/fare/status as the dominant information
Retain Pulse night visual identity and current map functionality
Make active ride and incoming request states visually distinct at a glance
Remove TEST T-001 and other test/debug chrome from the normal live driving surface
Never lead the console with an expired opportunity/event card
Separate Uber trip-mirroring controls from private Pulse ride controls so the two lifecycles do not visually compete
Preserve Uber mirror data capture but make it a clearly labeled secondary lane when no mirrored Uber trip is active
map: Evaluate MapLibre GL JS as an upgrade path from the current Leaflet presentation
Support route line, pickup/destination markers and active-trip focus when routing data is available

acceptance: Console looks like a purpose-built driver app rather than an admin dashboard
Incoming request, Scheduled, active Pulse ride, and Uber mirror mode are immediately distinguishable
Expired opportunity cards are filtered out of the live console
Test/debug target information is hidden from normal driving view
Uber mirror controls no longer dominate the primary Pulse ride surface when idle
No functional regression in QR, Inbox, map, shift, Uber mirroring, or rider lifecycle
